title: Ghost TPA
description: Lets you use teleport commands such as /tpa , /tpahere , /tpaccept
body:
A TPA plugin similar to Donut SMP. 
Uses a GUI to accept/reject teleport requests.
Usage of commands : 
/tpa <player>
/tpahere <player>
/tpaccept <player> 
Before you accept the players teleport request it shows their dimension , ping and avatar head.
